notes.title: Release date announcement!
notes.notes:
[h1]Release Date![/h1]

Big news on the horizon! We're setting our sights on the 14th of February 2024 for the official release date of our game. We've been fine-tuning every detail to ensure the best experience possible. The game is nearly complete; however, during testing, we encountered around 600 bugs - yikes! But fear not, our team's hard at work squashing those bugs and adding a few extra features to elevate your gameplay. 

We appreciate your patience and support. Stick around for more updates - we're dedicated to making this worth the wait. Thanks for being awesome!

[h2]New Prologue Build![/h2]

[url=https://jrpg.com/anime-dating-sim-iragon-update-0-95-50]Click here to watch our new weekly update video![/url]


[b]Scene Updates[/b]
Welcome back to another Iragon changelog. This week we have finished the VR scene for the Harbinger Boss Intro. You will be able to test it next week. While we were working on the Intro we also made progress on the Harbinger Boss Outro scene.

[b]Sex Minigame Overhaul[/b]
Additionally, we’ve overhauled the Sex Minigame. It is now more dynamic and features randomized animation.

[b]Key Rebinding & Options Changes[/b]
Lastly, we’ve made visual improvements to the Options Menu, as well as adding the option to rebind controls, as it was a long awaited feature.

[b]Post Process and Sky -[/b] This week we decided to do some recoloring in a few different levels, so that they have a better atmosphere and feel. We changed some post processing settings in the Village level before and after you’ve entered the Tavern. We also changed some skies, added a custom post process to some of the rooms in the Experimental hall and a few other places. 

[b]Animations - [/b]What makes a cutscene look good is good animations. We continue working on our animations, polishing them, creating new ones and adding them to our scenes. This week the Avoch cutscene got some new animations, some new particles, physics and last but not least face animations for Darick. 

[b]Outfits and Materials -[/b] We made new materials and textures for the outfits of the Avoch town people, both the male and female civilians. We also did some improvements on the destructible clothing for the warrior girls.

[b]New Art and Others -[/b] We’ve been reworking the camp area level to make it more cozy, romantic and delightful. We moved the blacksmith and the upgrades shop towards the exit of the level. We added new art and decorations, a whole new campfire with new fire crackling sounds and effects. Apart from that, we added chapter images for each chapter of the story. Some are finished and some are still placeholders.

notes.title: Girl Adventure Game - Iragon Anime Game Update 33
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=7oQkAGlwnQ4;full][/previewyoutube]


Hello everyone, we have a new update video with all the things we have been working on lately. We have concentrated on fixing game performance issues and code related issues. And in the meantime we are working on new character additions to the village so it can look more alive. Check out the video to see all the major changes we've made. 

[b]Changelog for build 7.22.20:[/b]

[b]Combat changes[/b] - Fighting lots of enemies at once now works a bit differently. If you are against a big group, they will come to fight you two at a time, the rest will stay at a bit of a distance. The ones who are waiting will have their guard up and you will do very little damage to them until you kill the ones that are fighting you at that moment. We made it work this way so that you can’t just kill the ones that are waiting while they are not trying to fight you.

[b]Experimental Girl[/b] - We are working on another girl for the village, but she’s not ready to be fully implemented yet. You can find her in the experimental level.

[b]Sunbathing Girl[/b] - The sunbathing girl has been replaced with another girl who is a bit more dressed. She still needs to be retextured, so look forward to that.

[b]Villager Girls[/b] - There are new girls who moved into the village. Some of you might remember them from a way older build. One is standing around near one of the houses and if you bump into her, she talks to you a bit. The other is near the tavern.

[b]Profiling & Optimization[/b] - We have known for a while that we have a problem with low fps in quite a few places throughout the game and we finally started working on improving that. Most levels have been profiled and we have pinpointed the issues that we need to fix. Some of them have already been worked on a bit and a bunch are still on the waiting list. We are also making a plan on how to handle level streaming which should significantly improve performance. All of this takes a lot of time and effort so please be patient. We will keep you updated on how things are going and which parts of the game have seen improvements in fps.

Hello everyone, this is our update video with all the major changes made to our anime game Iragon. We have new art, a new character and a few other changes shown in the video.

This is the changelog for build 7.10.20:

[b]Intimate Scene Improvements[/b] – The intimate scene is becoming more and more interactive and turning into something like a minigame. You will see a progress bar that fills up as you pleasure the girl. As it fills up you will unlock new positions that make her go faster and faster, until she can’t take any more.

[b]Parry Tutorial[/b] – Right after finishing the spell tutorial, you will now go through parry training. You will have to parry the attacks of some skeletons. But don’t worry, since this is the first time that you will have to do this, time will stop as they attack so that you can position your sword correctly.

[b]Sunbathing Girl[/b] – A new girl has shown up in the village and it seems that she really enjoys sunbathing almost naked at the lake.

[b]Tutorial Level Art[/b] – The spell/parry tutorial level now has art. You will get to learn how to fight and enjoy the scenery.

[b]Portal Changes[/b] – The portals that stop you from progressing before you complete a certain task have a new look.
